m: A warrior with a *tattoo* on his chest raises a *standing knife* to **kill**. (Today this is mostly the surname Liu.)
A *small speech bubble* rises over a *shopping basket* of books marked with a *cross*: the child **reads aloud** from each.
One *mouth* on a *hillside* steps on a *nail*, and the other *mouth* echoes back: "**ah**!"
A *runner* waves a *knife*-shaped baton, *mouth* wide open, and sprints past the leader: he **overtakes** him.
A *bent knife* cuts your name off the list: you are **exempt** from the chore.
A *cliff* face and a heavy *clod* of earth on top: everything below is **pressed** flat.
Beside the *gold coins*, a pile of shiny metal catches the *glare* of the lamp: **silver**.
A *big man* in a *hood* hands over *two sparks* of coin at the market stall: he **buys** something.
A *white dove* flies above the *king* of kings: the **emperor**.
A sheep's head above, a person's legs below: the shepherd who **raises** animals and children.
A *standing person* bows to the *magistrate* and says, in old poetic style, "**you**, sir."
Under the *awning*, the *standing heart* holds a *fortune stick* close to the **bosom**.
A *helping hand* closes tight around a *pill*: it **grasps** it and won't let go.
A *standing knife* cuts a second portion from the *full jar*: the **secondary** share, for the deputy.
A wagging *tongue* on a *ski* slides all over the place: everything is **in disorder**.
A *helping hand* holds up a *lid* and a *small table* as a shield: it **resists** the attack.
A *prowling dog* bites a *bowing man*: the dog has **offended** against the rules.
Down the *road* someone runs after a cart dropping *sandbags*: they **chase** it.
You carry *wheat* up the *hillside* and a friend wipes your brow with a *towel*: they **help** you.
From the *roof* a herald faces the *horizon* and **announces** the news to the whole land.
A *standing person* stands so still, holding a *bow*, it is **as if** he were a statue.
On the *mountain* you watch the *dusk moon* rise each night; one more **year of age** has passed.
A *boat* with a *lid* of deck and a *small table* for the chart: ready to **sail**.
A *standing person* has one tiny *wart*, but otherwise is **excellent** in every way.
My *standing heart* jumps: a *right hand* is poking out of the *soil*! How **strange**.
A *grain stalk* of rice ripens in the warm *sun* and smells so **fragrant**.
In the *grass* a man with *grey hair* is still reading in the *sun*: the action is **in progress**.
An *archway* of paths divides the *soil* into four plots: a **field**.
*Gold coins* are worth less than the tip of a *lost arrow*, made of strong **iron**.
A *helping hand* holds a lever in a *cave* above a *workbench*: it **controls** the machine.
The farmer's *grain stalk* is carried off on *legs* by a man with *horns* on his helmet and a greedy *mouth*: the **tax** collector.
The *left hand* holds the *workbench* still while the right does the work: the **left** side.
The *left hand* stays still while the other hand feeds your *mouth*: the **right** hand.
A *standing person* cuts the cake and hands each guest one **portion**.
A *cave* where a *fang* has bitten right through the rock: it **pierces** it.
A *swan* swims through the *grass*, as graceful as **art**.
Two *spoons* lean back to back under the *moon*: they turn their **backs**.
On the *hillside* the war *carts* line up in a **troop formation**.
*Grass* grows wild in the *sun* around a wooden *cross*: a field of **grass**.
Under the *moon* a *kneeling man* brushes *soil* off his *elbow* and his sore **foot**.
A *tree* seen with a *turned head*: you get only a **general** idea of it.
A *heart* that sneers at its *silver medal* and wants gold at any cost: **evil**.
A *person* breaks off a **chunk** of *soil* with a spade.
At the *cross* of roads the reader catches his sleeve on a *root hook* and turns a *page*: he **pauses**.
An old man shakes his *cane* at a tiger: he really **dares**.
Under the *roof* a *thumb* rests on the lock all night: he **guards** the house.
*Water drops* trickle into a *wine jug*: rice **wine**.
A *mountain* sticking out of the sea with a bird on top: an **island**.
A *helping hand* holds out a *grass blade*: "keep this safe for me," it **entrusts** you.
A *big man* stands right under the *archway*: in the **centre**.
A *lying man* sleeps behind the door while one *drop* of lamp oil burns: a single **household**.
A *skeleton* and a *standing knife* are thrown on the glowing *embers*: the fire grows **intense**.
*Water drops* stretch as far as a *sheep* could ever wander: the **ocean**.
Two *nails* and two *mouths*, one on top of the other: the taller one is the **elder brother**.
You pull a *silk skein* apart thread by thread to **search** for the lost needle.
Under the *moon* a man with a *cross* stitched on his *mouth* rides off wild and **reckless**.
Someone *yawns* as the clerk reads the long contract out **section** by section.
A *cow head* with a *mouth* full of grass and a bird with *spread wings* **lean on** each other.
A *small speech bubble* floats over a *drying rack* hung with *horns*: everyone **comments** on the odd sight.
A *right hand* carves a *wood slice* by a *leaning cliff*: a **printing block**.
Under the *roof* a *jade gem* is hidden: the family **treasure**.
In the *shed* two *persons* sit on the *soil*: each takes a **seat**.
*Animal tracks* in the snow: the hunter **explains** which beast went where.
The *sun* glints on *crumbs* of white rock far below: lovely **scenery**.
By the *cliff* a *bowing man* turns each *page* of the patient's chart: he **looks after** him.
A little boy with *horns* on his cap aims a *slingshot*: the cheeky **younger brother**.
*Spread feet* stand on a *bean* pole, then **climb** up it.
A *standing person* trades a *spoon* for a *shell*: **goods** change hands.
Two *pig snouts* nose each other across a *plank*: a **mutual** greeting.
A *standing person* presses coins with a *thumb* into the seller's palm: he **pays**.
A *standing person* with hair as white as a *white dove*: your father's elder brother, **uncle**.
My *standing heart* beats lazily in the warm *sun*: everything is **slow**.
An *open crate* is cut open with *scissors* and a sailor *yawns*: the long ship from **Europe** has arrived.
A *helping hand* passes a *bent knife* to a *big man* under the *archway*: they **exchange** goods.
An *ear* pressed to the *gate*: you **hear** the news.
A *bowing man* clings to the edge of a *cliff* while a *bent knife* swings overhead: **danger**!
My *standing heart* has no time even to visit the *tombstone*: I am too **busy**.
A *person* under a *tree* spits out the hard **pit** of a plum.
The *sun* sets, the *music* fades: the room is **dark**.
A *woman* holds the *stepladder* steady for her siblings: the **older sister**.
A *person* stands between two others and **introduces** them.
*Soil* under the *awning* rots, and the *fortune stick* foretells **bad** luck.
A *small speech bubble* and a *thumb* raised: everyone **discusses** the plan.
A *plank* above two little rooms with a girl in each window: what a **beautiful** house.
A *drop* of honey softens a stern *glare*: now he looks **good** and kind.
In the *shed*, with one *elbow* on the bench, you untangle a *fishing line* in **order**.
A *slide* of smoke **rises** over the *grass*.
A guard watches each *dish* from above: he **supervises** the kitchen.
A man bends low over the cliff edge and looks down: he **faces** the sea below.
A lamp on a *small table* under the roof: the room is **bright**.
*Rain* has fallen overnight; a *kicking foot* and *trudging feet* splash, and a *mouth* tastes the morning **dew**.
A single *drop* of water flowing on and on in the river: **forever**.
A *mouth* blows a *whistle* to **call** the dog.
A *mouth* bites the first fruit from a *sapling*: what a **taste**.
Beyond the *village*, with an *elbow* on the fence, you cast a *fishing line* into the **wild field** streams.
A *strong arm* and a *mouth* full of nails nail *tree* poles together: a **frame**.
*Soil* around a *guard post*: the guarded **region**.
*Water drops* wash a *pinch* of tiny grains onto the beach: **sand**.
A *helping hand* lets go of a *little fortune stick* in the *sun* by a *cross*: it **drops**.
A *helping hand* points at your *tongue*: "say all the names, **include** everyone."
A *watcher* stands on the deck of a huge grey *boat* with guns: a **warship**.
Head, scaled body and a tail fin on a *plank*: a **fish** on the chopping board.
A *crowbar* pries open a crate with a *cross* on it and out spill *crumbs* of everything: all **mixed** up.
A *small speech bubble* from a *mouth* says the *sky* is green: a **mistake**.
*Water drops* curve like a *bow* under a *lid* of cliffs: a sheltered **bay**.
A *scholar* opens his *mouth* to say good words: a **lucky** day.
*Icicles* on the *cliff* are hacked by a *halberd* while a *covered mouth* stays quiet: the ice **decreases**.
At the *door* under the *archway*, *silk thread* and *grass* are **woven** into a mat.
Two *trees* and a *bolt of cloth* hung between them: the screen is bright and **clear**.
A *stop sign* under the *moon*, but the driver nods: he is **willing** to wait.
*Water drops* are poured over a *shell* and marked with a *standing knife*: you **measure** how much it holds.
A *cane* smashes the *shell* coins out of the enemy's hand: he is **defeated**.
A *lying man* rests where the *arrow landing* stops: home, his **house**.
A *kicking foot* leaps from the *blanket* where a *cobra* is hiding: **run**!
Two *trees* under the *dusk moon*: you fall asleep and **dream** of a forest.
A *cane* swings and the crowd **scatters**.
*Water drops* in a *dish* left in the *sun*: **warm** water.
A *tree* grows inside a *fence* and cannot spread its branches: it is **trapped**.
A *standing knife* so long it reaches the top of the *tent*: a **sword**.
*Water drops* drip on a *cart* left by an *axe* until it rusts **gradually** away.
Two lumps of *soil* pressed down with a *thumb*: the box is **sealed**.
*Splashing water* and a *cane* held out to someone drowning: you **save** him.
A *tied sack* of *shells*: very **expensive** treasure.
A *person* aims a *tree*-wood rifle while a *bowing man* ducks: a **gun**.
A *person* finds the *clay jar* has a crack: water leaks, and he **lacks** a drink.
A *woman* stores *rice* on every floor of a *tree*-wood tower: a tall **building**.
A *stepladder* leaning on an *elbow* of land: the little **county** office on the hill.
A *mouth* under a roof with smoke still rising: someone is **still** cooking.
A single strand of *fur* on a brush: just a **tiny bit**.
A *grain stalk* carried under one *dusk moon*, then another *dusk moon*: it **moves** night after night.
A *woman* cooks a *good meal* for her children: **mother**.
Two *moons* side by side in the sky: **friends**.
A *plank* frames a little sketch in a box: you **draw** a picture.
Two *kings* sit side by side at school: they are in the same **class**.
An *arrow* of thought, a *mouth* to speak, the *sun* to light it: **wisdom**.
Under the *lid*, one bean, then another: you have this **also**.
*Two planks* and *two planks* make the ridges of an **ear**.
A *big man* inside a *fence* shares his *heart* with strangers: great **kindness**.
An *arrow* no longer than a *bean*: very **short**.
A *hand* opened flat: the **palm**.
At the *workbench* a *sail* flaps and my *heart* jumps: I am **afraid**.
On the *road* someone drops a *tied sack* full of *shells*: they **leave** it **behind**.
A *cross* nailed over the *mouth* of the gate inside a *fence*: shut and **solid**.
A *towel* spread on the floor of the shed: a woven **mat** to sit on.
Under the *tree*, behind the *curtains*, an *elbow* pushes the belt **loose**.
A *grain stalk* hides a *pinned heart*: a **secret** love note.
A *small speech bubble* rises as your *torso* bows and a *thumb* goes up: you **thank** them.
A *fish* rots in the *sun* and someone eats it anyway: how **crass**.
On the *road* under an *archway* you see a *paw print*: you **meet** a bear.
In the *shed* a *servant* sweeps and cooks: the household stays **healthy**.
